designGoal: make the smallest attributable post-v0.4 architecture revision that improves implicit known-route fallback uniqueness/recall without weakening the already successful safety boundary

routeability.reason: preserve attribution: first test whether Fallback Identity structure alone can recover enough reachable known rows while maintaining v0.4 safety

selectionAndFinalization.selectionSemantics: Arbitration route when accepted; otherwise Fallback route only when Fallback returns one accepted identity; unresolved otherwise

from.decision: apply one global admission threshold independently to all 22 probabilities; select iff exactly one route is admitted

to.scores: one normalized 22-class probability distribution over the same frozen 512-dimensional question vector
to.acceptance: select the argmax route iff its maximum softmax probability is greater than or equal to one globally calibrated confidence threshold; otherwise unresolved
to.rejectAllEquivalent: max probability below global confidence threshold

interpretation: v0.4 independent binary admissions spend capacity on 22 separate yes/no boundaries although the Fallback decision is mutually exclusive when it succeeds
a 22-class softmax makes route identity mutually exclusive by construction and removes the multiple-admission branch without adding a second threshold
one global maximum-confidence threshold preserves explicit abstention and the project-wide prohibition on route-specific thresholds
Routeability remains unchanged in v0.5 so any change in integrated development can be attributed primarily to Fallback Identity v0.3 rather than a bundled upstream recall change

fallbackV03TrainingContractDirection.labels: exactly one of the frozen current 22 routes for route-known training rows
fallbackV03TrainingContractDirection.reason: non-route examples should calibrate abstention through the single global confidence threshold rather than introduce a synthetic 23rd semantic route

attributionRules.ifV05FailsDueRouteabilityRecall: freeze v0.5 failure and consider Routeability revision only in a later new Candidate version rather than bundling a rescue into v0.5
attributionRules.ifV05FailsDueFallbackPrecisionOrSafety: freeze v0.5 failure and redesign Fallback in a later version; no same-version post-hoc threshold rescue
